實作

Translation status: 繁體中文 reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the zh-Hant pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Declares that a type implements one or more 待實作介面 contracts.

Aliases: implements

Syntax: 類型 <name> 實作 <interface-list> <block>

Category#

type

Related#

  • 類型
  • 待實作介面

Examples#

radix/corpus/implet/implet.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Declares that a type implements one or more 待實作介面 contracts.

# =============================================================================
# 實作 — Declares that a type implements one or more 待實作介面 contracts
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Declares that a type implements one or more 待實作介面 contracts.
#   • Related keywords: 類型, 待實作介面
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Declaring `類型 實作 Implendum` without implementing all required methods — every method signature in the 待實作介面 must have a body in the 類型.
#
# See also: 類型, 待實作介面
# =============================================================================

# 實作 — 類型 implements a 待實作介面 (interface contract)
#
# 類型 Nomen 實作 Implendum { … }
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   genusDecl :← '類型' ident '實作' ident '{' methodDecl* '}'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   implet.expected — Aurelia from 待實作介面 plenum().

interface Nominatum {
    fn plenum() → string
}

class Civis implements Nominatum {
    var string 名稱

    fn plenum() → string {
        # satisfies 待實作介面 requirement
        return "§"(self.nomen)
    }
}

main {
    const Civis civis ← Civis { 名稱 = "Aurelia" }
    print civis.plenum()
}

Expected output:

Aurelia
